identity: A shuffled bank of Arabic film/TV subtitle lines - colloquial-leaning MSA dialogue in fan-translation quality (misspellings throughout: السنيما, السنويه, الامتعه, فى, يحبنى, أعتناق, ان for أن). Consecutive <NL> lines are semantically unrelated to each other (a call to a department head, a text message, grandpa Drake's flying lessons, movie stars in the house, a 1631-dollar raise, a Korean-drama vocative 'أيها الملك', sprinklers, prison), so this is a line bank, not a transcript; one line even repeats verbatim (لدي مال بحقيبتي at 101-103 and again at 105-107), which is the signature of a shuffled/deduplicated sentence bank. 322 tokens, 46 <NL> tokens, 47 lines.
law: THE LINE IS THE SENTENCE. Each <NL>-delimited line is exactly one utterance = one unit, so effectively every boundary here is the mandatory pre-<NL> one plus the final token. The document contains NO line-internal clause-level connective anywhere - not one mid-line و, ف, ثم, حيث, إذ, كما, بينما or لكن in 47 lines - so my master conjunct-weight law (doctrine section 0), which drives most of my doctrine, has almost no purchase on this text. The only line-internal candidates are PRE-POSED PARTICLES: response particles (لا, نعم, أجل), a vocative (أيها الملك), an oath frame (أقسم بالمسيح), and one curse (تبا). The rule I apply to them: a pre-posed element that carries NO predication of its own is absorbed by the clause it introduces (short-tail brake 0b; two-clause budget 0c) - it is cut off only when the two sides are distinct speech acts with zero syntactic linkage, i.e. neither governs the other, in which case asyndetic dialogue cutting applies (E1).
reasoning: Checklist item 1 first - classify the genre before reading for content. This is neither running prose nor a list, table, MCQ, drill or verse; it is a subtitle line bank whose natural unit is the line. Two document-internal facts settled it. FACT 1: across all 47 lines there is not a single line containing two unambiguous independent finite sentences; every line parses as one sentence, at most with a pre-posed particle. FACT 2: the bank is demonstrably willing to emit a one-word unit (سأطهو @228, هيكوك @236 each occupy a whole line), yet not one standalone لا / نعم / أجل line appears anywhere, while FIVE lines begin with such a particle. If the source had put terminal punctuation after those particles, the upstream splitter would have emitted them as their own lines, exactly as it did for سأطهو and هيكوك. That asymmetry is direct evidence that this corpus does not split a line-initial response particle. Default therefore: no line-internal cut. Now the hard sites, argued individually. SITE @28 (لا | أنا حقا يجب أن أرتفع), SITE @238 (نعم | قال بأنه يفضل أن يذهب معي من أي شخص آخر), SITE @250 (لا | لقد تفقدت الرشاشات): in each, a response particle is followed by a COMPLETE independent sentence, and each side could stand alone as a corpus sentence. These are my three closest calls and my main exposure on this document. For cutting: my batch-1 calibration is roughly 7:1 toward under-segmentation, and checklist item 4 tells me to justify NOT cutting rather than the reverse. Against, and this is what I took: the particle carries zero predication, so the master law's own arithmetic - roughly one finite predication per unit - assigns the whole line a single chunk; the short-tail brake 0b absorbs a one-word non-parallel dependent head; and FACT 2 is document-internal evidence that beats a cross-genre prior (my 7:1 bias was measured on و/ف-chained encyclopedic and classical prose where both sides carried predications - not on interjections in dialogue, and my one dialogue document in batch 1, doc_9d15d9d5d637, was my best prose score at 92.0 with no interjection errors). NOT CUT at all three. SITE @153 (أجل | أنا): weaker than the three above - what follows the particle is an elliptical fragment (أنا), not a sentence, and the whole line is two words. NOT CUT. SITE @84 (أقسم بالمسيح | أنا لا أعرف): the one place in the document where both sides carry a finite verb (أقسم, أعرف), so the predication arithmetic superficially argues for a cut. I declined it on 0c: two finite clauses totalling five words sit comfortably inside one unit's budget, and أقسم بالمسيح is a performative oath frame whose jawab is syntactically bound to it, not an independent assertion. NOT CUT. SITE @203 (أيها الملك | أنها سا وول): a vocative. Doctrine E5 is direct evidence that a vocative rides with its clause - gold kept على رسلكما أيتها الصديقتان together and placed the boundary at the following full clause لا تتخاصما. NOT CUT. SITE @114 (تبا | المعذرة): the ONE cut I take, and the only line-internal boundary in my answer. Unlike every other candidate, neither side governs the other: تبا is a curse and المعذرة an apology directed at a different addressee, with no syntactic relation of any kind, so no single-sentence parse exists except a loose comma splice. Asyndeton in dramatic dialogue cuts (E1), the two parts are distinct speech acts, and this corpus is demonstrably willing to make a one-word unit. Confidence lo, because if the bank treats the whole line as one entry this is a false cut - it is the one place I deliberately spend precision to hedge my documented merge bias. TWO FURTHER SITES CHECKED AND REJECTED. @219 (بدأت باخباري أشياء عن ولدي أنه كسول | وأنه غير مؤدب) is the document's only line-internal و. The conjunct-weight test superficially fires - وأنه غير مؤدب has its own subject and its own nominal predicate - and B2 says parallelism defeats the short-tail rule. But B2 was derived from N parallel MAIN clauses (السمع يدرك / والبصر يدرك / والشم يدرك); here both أنه كسول and وأنه غير مؤدب are أنّ-complements, objects of باخباري inside a single reporting clause, and أنّ belongs to the tight-subordinator family (الذي / لأن / حتى) that never opens a unit. Ten-word line, inside budget. NO CUT. @139-@147 (عندما كان بيخلص بطاقة الفيزا | كان بالبيت يراقب ذلك) is subordinate-plus-main under عندما, one sentence. NO CUT. Finally, the لا at @69, @109, @162, @191, @261, @296, @300 and @308 are all verbal or nominal negators, not interjections, and were never candidates - only the لا at @28 and @250 are response particles. Net result: 47 mandatory boundaries (one before each of the 46 <NL> tokens, plus the final token 321) and exactly one discretionary cut at @114.
